::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
1. Setiap minggu, Senin adalah kelas materi dan Rabu adalah sesi lab tutorial.
2. Tutorial **tidak wajib** dikerjakan dan tidak dinilai langsung - tapi setiap minggu ada **Individual Assignment** dengan topik yang sama, jadi mengerjakan tutorialnya akan sangat membantu.
3. Mahasiswa dapat bertanya kepada asisten dosen selama jam sesi lab.
4. Sangat disarankan tetap mengerjakan tiap tutorial - pola yang dipelajari di tutorial langsung dipakai ulang di Individual Assignment minggu yang sama (lihat menu Tugas).
:::
::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
1. Every week, Monday is the lecture and Wednesday is the tutorial lab session.
2. Tutorials are **not mandatory** and are not graded directly - but every week has an **Individual Assignment** on the same topic, so doing the tutorial helps a lot.
3. Students may ask teaching assistants questions during the lab session.
4. Doing each tutorial is still strongly recommended - the pattern you learn there gets reused directly in that same week's Individual Assignment (see the Assignments menu).
:::
